reason: Models std::panic::Location::file(), which genuinely returns &'static str in real Rust; only ever constructed from a literal call site ("proof.rs"). Converting to an owned String would compile but would misrepresent the real API surface this type exists to mirror.

Two #[cfg]-gated definitions of decide share one name: the #[cfg(not(kani))] sibling genuinely reads bytes (real is_valid_utf8 computation, exercised by tests/utf8_model_test.rs's TooLong/InvalidUtf8 cases), while under Kani validity is asserted symbolically via kani::any() and the byte content is genuinely irrelevant. No single parameter name is honest for both; the underscore here reflects that this specific (kani) definition truly ignores its argument.
